testcase.system-out: Scenario Outline: Cancel a file chooser while a ribbon edit is pending ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And 2D Sketches has been staged in the target list ✔ When the user clicks Import ✔ Then the Import Customization Settings file chooser opens ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the file chooser ✔ Then the file chooser closes ✔ And 2D Sketches remains in the Part Tools target list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ And Apply and cancels are available in the customization dialog ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
